claim_to_evidence.computations: verify_fan.py: exact flip-edge enumeration for n=3..7, full exact level-integration for small n, 19496 integer normal equality tests, eight non-path cone profiles.
claim_to_evidence.domain: Connected graph cones over finite trees; sharp complete classification for unweighted fan graphical zonotopes K_1 join P_n with n>=3 and uniform support-offset averaging.
proof_steps: Integrated crossing-length count for all zonotope edges
Graphical-arrangement chamber identification for each edge contraction
Chromatic polynomial evaluation for cone over forest
Sharp two-ended path triangle inequality and equality analysis
claim_to_evidence.unproved_limits: No classification of extrema for general tree cones, no statements about uniform-orientation sampling, no independent validation.

integrity_statement: The section-edge identity, acyclic-orientation correspondence, and chromatic polynomial evaluation are cited as prior mathematics. The asserted result is the derived explicit tree-cone profile and exact sharp fan optimization, including every equality direction. Reproducibility uses standalone exact-integer and rational finite checks; these do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: The extremal range and equality normals are proved for the standard unweighted fan K_1 join P_n, n at least 3. An exact tree-cone directional formula holds more generally but does not optimize arbitrary tree cones. Literature novelty remains subject to unlocated equivalent older results, and no independent audit has occurred.
title: Sharp slice-averaged vertex counts for fan graphical zonotopes
